_purpose: Floors for the detection regression gate. CI runs the harnesses with --gate and fails if any figure drops below its floor. Floors raised on the follow-up branch after the second-source rules (measured, see docs/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md cycle 7). Set B Tier 2 stays at 3: its fourth hit is a side effect of Unicode normalisation chosen while the Tier 2 miss list was known, so it is not counted. They are floors, not targets. Raising a floor after a measured improvement is fine. Lowering one needs the reason written in the commit that does it.

_sources.httpParamsDev: audit/eval_dev_inprocess.ts on the dev half of HttpParamsDataset, split by audit/split_external.ts. The sealed half is never scored in CI.
